target: next session close/open - 1; signal after previous close
purge: training target date strictly before earliest evaluation raw feature start (40 market sessions)
neural_selection: lowest 2016 validation MSE epoch; freeze epochs for test refits
strategy: top 20 forecasts strictly above fixed threshold; 1/20 NAV per slot including entry costs; flat overnight
benchmark: fixed equal-dollar basket of 20 highest median dollar-volume stocks during 2016; buy first test open, hold to final test close
test_policy: no test selection; expanding refits use only earlier labels after purge; all models same observations
uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap of daily MSE improvement versus zero, block 20, 2000 resamples, seed 42
